# AMEVA-Cluster (v1.0.0)
> Symmetric Disaggregated Mobile RAM Pooling & On-Device AI Acceleration Runtime with Compute-Memory Decoupling

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-cluster
- Installation: `pip install ameva-cluster
# or
npm install -g @ameva/cluster`
- Architecture: AMEVA-Cluster unifies idle LPDDR memory across multiple heterogeneous mobile smartphones into a single disaggregated memory pool using a symmetric master/worker binary.
Compute is fully isolated on a single flagship GPU, while edge phones serve strictly as passive RAM caches, completely preventing thermal throttling and Android Low Memory Killer (LMK) SIGKILL terminations.
Features built-in storage-assisted hybrid failover to local UFS 3.1 flash mmap streaming and fast-path HMAC mutual authentication Guard proxies.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
from ameva_cluster import AmevaCluster, ClusterMaster

# 1. Start worker daemon with Guard protection on remote phone:
# ameva-cluster worker --port 50052

# 2. Execute distributed inference across phone fleet:
AmevaCluster.run_master(
    model_path="Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf",
    workers=["100.106.251.21:50052", "100.77.47.37:50052"],
    tensor_split="40,30,30",
    prompt="Explain disaggregated neural memory architecture."
)

```
